name: Ancestry Barbarians know the Fill Level passive required by Keg Smash's Tankard tooltip (#9919)
contract: Keg Smash 805808 requires the free Ancestry Fill Level node 4003, which grants visible passive 92083.
Its Spell.dbc description renders the Tankard consumption sentence only when the player knows hidden passive
500061. That passive already supplies the Fill Level periodic aura and ancestor-heal proc, so knowing Keg Smash
without knowing 500061 leaves the authored tooltip incomplete. An existing character who lacks 500061 relearns it
from 92083 on login without changing the mechanic's acquisition boundary.

steps.label: SETUP: Ancestry grants the visible Fill Level passive
DISCRIMINATING: the hidden Fill Level passive is known for the tooltip conditional
An existing character lacks the hidden passive
The visible Fill Level passive teaches it again on login
